annotations.title: Full-size print template as SVG and DXF

description: The full-size template a calculator page prints: a stair stringer or step gauge, rafter cuts, a cone or frustum pattern, an arch's centring or voussoirs, an anchor bolt setting jig or plate, a curved plate; its lines as SVG and DXF, its checks and omissions, and how it tiles on paper.

calculator.description: The calculator whose page offers the template: a stair stringer and step gauge, a rafter, a cone or frustum pattern, a curved wall's plate, an anchor bolt setting board or plate, an arch's centring or voussoirs.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

fields.description: The template's own figures by id (a stringer's board depth and tread thickness, a cone's lap …), with units; left out, the page's defaults for the system (or the calculator's own figure where the page opens on it). The answer lists them.

formats.description: The drawings to return. Left out, both.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

inputs.description: The calculator's own inputs by id, with their units, as its page takes them; left out, the values its page opens on.

kind.description: Which of the family's two templates: stringer gauge or whole; rafter cuts or whole; cone whole or half; arch centring or voussoirs; bolts setting or plate; plate segment or whole. Left out, the first.

overlap.description: Between adjacent sheets. Left out, 10 mm.

paper.description: Left out, A4 for metric and Letter for imperial.

rollWidth.description: With paper roll: the roll's width.

system.description: The unit system inputs left out open in, and the one the page link opens in. The answer comes in both.

name: print_template

dxf.description: The template's lines as a DXF (R12, millimetres).

text.description: In the system asked for, then the other.

svg.description: The template's lines at full size, millimetre units.

text.description: In the system asked for, then the other.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
